summary: Mr. Arking discusses different customs regarding when Mizmor Shir Hanukkat Habayit LeDavid is said during Shaharit on Hanukkah. He examines opinions on whether to add the first verse of the Mizmor before Hashem Melech during the eight days of Hanukkah. He presents sources from Halab, Argentina, the Land of Israel, and Brooklyn regarding these prayer customs.

questions: At what point in Shaharit is Mizmor Shir Hanukkat Habayit LeDavid said on Hanukkah?
